problem_statement: Since the payments platform 2.3 release the legacy `send_funds` call is gone from the payments client, so every approved tranche now fails with an AttributeError and `tests/test_disbursement.py` is red. Please migrate `tranche_desk/disbursement.py` to the v2 API (`PaymentsClient.submit(TransferInstruction)`), following the sketch the payments team left in `reference/`. The `tranche.disbursed` event should carry the `transfer_id` and `status` from the returned receipt. Keep the `register` signature as is; the wiring in deployment passes the same collaborators.

unrelated_note.neutral: Helpers that format cent amounts and tranche references for statements and log lines.
